mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing equity attractiveness relative to fixed income and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS decline periods (by >0.25pp) are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) relative to baseline return.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 2.5% signals heightened inflation expectations that increase the probability of premature monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in CPIAUCSL yoy >2.5% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) relative to baseline return.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market overheating that accelerates inflation and triggers Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in PAYEMS>0.5% and UNRATE>0.1pp decline periods are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) relative to baseline return.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion regimes, rising housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1200 thousand units signal robust consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in HOUST>1200 periods during early-cycle expansion are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) relative to baseline return.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns in UNRATE decline periods (by >0.1pp) are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) relative to baseline return.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in INDPRO decline >0.5% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) relative to baseline return.

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.3% and 0.2% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand that accelerates economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in HOUST>0.3% and RSAFS>0.2% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) relative to baseline return.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, quarterly GDP growth falling below 2.0% signals economic deceleration that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in GDPC1 growth <2.0% periods during late-cycle expansion are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) relative to baseline return.
